contact.adminInviteCopy: Copy this now — it is shown once.
contact.adminNeedName: Write their name, so you know who they are.
contact.adminOpenLinkHint: Paste this into a group chat. Anyone who opens it gets the form; nobody gets in without you.
contact.adminSignIn: Sign in with the address that owns this journal to see who is waiting.

contact.codeIntro: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. Type it in and you're done.
contact.codeWrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
contact.deleteHint: Removes your name, your address and your access. It cannot be undone.
contact.deleted: You're gone. Nothing of yours is left.
contact.doneBody: That's everything we need. {title} will wave you in, and you'll get an email when they do.
contact.emailHint: We send one short code to check the address is really yours.
contact.error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
contact.gone: This link no longer works. Fill the form in again to get a new one.
contact.intro: Leave your details here and we'll keep you posted from the road. Nothing is sent until you say so.
contact.mailApprovedBody: {title} let you in. Follow along whenever you like.
contact.mailCodeBody: Your code is {code}. It works for ten minutes.
contact.mailCodeIgnore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore it — nothing has changed.
contact.mailRequestBody: {name} ({email}) confirmed their email address and would like to follow along.
contact.manageIntro: Change anything here whenever you like. No password, no account.
contact.name: Your name
contact.needAddress: For a postcard we need a street, a town and a country.
contact.needEmail: That address doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
contact.needName: Please write your name, so we know who you are.
contact.title: Come along with us
contact.tooMany: That's a lot of tries. Wait a few minutes and try once more.
contact.unsubscribed: Done — we won't email you again.
contact.wantsDigest: Send me an email when there are new days to read

contact.welcomeBackBody: {title} waved you in some time ago, so there’s nothing to wait for — your details are updated and you can start reading.
cost.budgetNote: Preparation counts as spent up front; the daily allowance is what is left, divided by the days we planned for.
cost.byCountryNote: Totals, with the daily rate for each country beside them.
cost.cumulativeNote: Starting from what we'd already spent before leaving.
cost.disclaimer: Prices are what {travellers} actually paid, converted to {currency} at the rate on the day.
cost.private: The numbers on this trip are shared with guests only.
cost.subtitle: Everything we spend, in {currency} — from the visas and jabs before we left to today's coffee. Kept honest so you can judge what a trip like this really takes.
cost.title: What the trip costs
cost.unconverted: Not counted in these totals: {amounts}. This trip’s rate table has no rate for them, so they are shown as they were paid rather than folded into a number that would look right and be wrong. Add the missing rates to the trip’s {file}.
currency.approxNote: Shown in {currency}, converted from {base} at European Central Bank reference rates from {date}. Approximate — the amounts actually paid are the ones in the table.
currency.approxNoteUndated: Shown in {currency}, converted from {base} at European Central Bank reference rates. Approximate — the amounts actually paid are the ones in the table.
currency.label: Currency
day.label: Day
digest.footer: You are getting this because you asked {site} to keep you posted.
digest.intro: Here is what has been written on {title} since we last wrote to you.
digest.moreOne: …and one more day on this trip.
digest.preferences: Change your language or stop these emails
digest.subject: {count} new days from {title}
digest.title: {count} new days since you last looked
digest.titleOne: One new day since you last looked
draft.body: Nobody else can read this day: it is absent from the story, the feed, the search index and its own link. Delete the {line} line from the file to publish it.
draft.title: Draft — only you can see this
err.crashBody: Not your connection, and not something you did. Try again — if it keeps happening it will be fixed from this side.
err.crashTitle: Something went wrong at our end
err.dayGoneBody: It may have been renamed since the link was sent. The story runs from the first day to the last, so you can find it from there.
err.dayGoneTitle: That day isn’t in this journal
err.linkExpiredBody: Links sent by email expire on purpose, and a deleted record takes its link with it. Fill the form in again and a fresh one arrives in a minute.
err.notSignedInTitle: You are not signed in here
err.offlineBody: The pages you have already read are still here. Anything new needs a connection — this page will work again as soon as you have one.
err.pageGoneBody: The link is probably older than the page it points at, or it picked up a stray character on the way. Nothing has been lost — everything is still where it was.
err.passwordChangedBody: You were let in before, so this is not a mistake on your part — whoever writes this trip set a new password. Ask them for it and enter it below.
err.passwordChangedTitle: The password for this trip has changed
err.tripGoneBody: It was taken down or renamed. The other trips are all still where they were.
err.tripGoneTitle: That trip isn’t here any more
err.unknownUserBody: Every journal here lives at the name of the person who writes it. Check the link you were sent — if you typed it in, one letter is usually all it takes.
err.unknownUserTitle: There is no journal at this address
gallery.description: Every photo and video from the trip, newest first — filterable by place.
gallery.subtitle: photos and videos, newest first.
gallery.title: Gallery
hero.newSince: new days since your last visit
hero.newSinceOne: new day since your last visit
hero.tagline: Follow along, one day at a time.
landing.handEmail: and an email address you control
landing.hero: A travel journal your agent writes for you.
landing.lede: Your trips are markdown and photographs in a folder you own. Read it in a browser. Write it by handing an agent a link and an email address.
landing.noEditor: There is no editing interface, and there won’t be one. The agent is the editor.
landing.publicNone: No journals yet. Copy content/example to content/<your-name> and reload.
landing.readersBody: You don’t need any of this. Follow the link you were sent.
landing.selfHostBody: A VPS, Node and Caddy, one deploy script. A public journal needs no database. AGPL-3.0.
landing.step1Body: It reads the guide there — every call, with examples.
landing.step2: Give it an email address you control
landing.step2Body: The one that owns the journal. No other address can write.
landing.step3: Pass back the code that arrives
landing.step3Body: It can then write for seven days. Everything it writes waits as a draft.
lang.label: Language
map.plannedFromDrafts: · some of these are drafts, visible only to you
map.plannedHint: dashed — where we still intend to go
map.subtitle: Tap any stop to see how long we stayed and what we shot there.
map.title: Where we've been
me.agentBody: Hand these two lines to an agent. It reads the guide there and asks you for a code.
me.agentTitle: To write, or to start a new trip
me.askOwner: There is nothing to fill in here — this journal keeps no guestbook. The link they send you is what lets you in.
me.detailsBody: Your name, language and postal address are yours to change. Nothing else on this site can be edited here — the journal is written by an agent.
me.nothing: Nothing yet. Ask whoever sent you here to invite you.
me.signInBody: If you have read this journal before, sign in with the same email address and we will send you a six-digit code.
me.signInSent: If that address has access, a code is on its way. It works for ten minutes.
me.signInWrong: That code did not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
me.signOutBody: This ends your session on this device. To come back you will need a new code by email, so only sign out if you are on somebody else's computer.
me.signOutFailed: That did not work, and you are still signed in. Try again.
me.strangerBody: If somebody sent you a link to this journal, follow it. To be added properly, ask them to invite you.
me.title: Your access
me.tokenBody: A code you read out becomes a key that works for seven days, on this journal and nothing else. It can write days — always as drafts — and it can never publish one. Publishing stays with you.
me.tokenWarning: It is not the same as being signed in here. Do not paste it into a page or a chat you did not start: anyone holding it can write to your journal until it expires.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked — turn them back on in your browser settings.
push.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
push.install.body: iPhones only allow notifications from pages added to the Home Screen. Do that once, and you’re set.
push.install.step3: Open it from the Home Screen, then turn notifications on
push.install.title: Get notified about new days
push.iosInstall: On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), then notifications can be switched on.
search.error: Search couldn't load — try reloading the page.
search.subtitle: Find any day by what happened, where, or what it was called.
search.title: Search
story.caughtUp: That's everything so far — more soon
story.dayFailed: This day couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then go back a day and forward again.
trips.noEntriesYet: No days written yet — this one hasn’t happened.
trips.subtitle: Everywhere we’ve been, and where we’re going next.
trips.title: Our trips
